policy.method: Subjective project-fit screening: map aesthetic (0–5) + useful settlement/regional/POI breadth (0–5), checked against downloaded files and contact sheets. Counts include variants, not distinct gameplay roles. Godot texture validation is separate from map-scale visual acceptance.
policy.source_retention: Previously staged rejected files stay under trials/ for provenance and rollback.

candidates.name: Game-icons
candidates.notes: Extensive RPG fantasy concepts; more interface-symbol than map engraving.

candidates.name: Mercator
candidates.notes: Capital/city use different city drawings. Village/hamlet use small-town drawings as scale proxies. No dedicated supernatural POIs.

candidates.name: de Fer
candidates.notes: Capital/city use manor-and-village combinations as scale proxies. Castle and ruins are verified individual members inside the Unique folder. No dedicated cave, lighthouse or mine.

candidates.name: Donia
candidates.notes: Church artwork is a religious-site proxy for monastery, not a dedicated monastery. No verified town/rural roles, so retained as a supplementary source rather than a viewer family.

candidates.name: Müller
candidates.notes: Capital uses walled city; hamlet uses a village dot. Trading uses a market town, not a caravanserai. Mineral symbols are not mine-entrance drawings, so mine remains absent.

candidates.name: Janssonius
candidates.notes: Capital/city use separate city variants. Maritime marks include abstract shipwreck symbols, not illustrated wrecked ships. Missing rural and religious roles.

candidates.name: Super Rough RPG/HEX
candidates.licence: Author grants unrestricted use; verify redistribution
candidates.notes: Capital uses castle. Dungeon icon is not a cave and is retained separately. White interior fills are part of source artwork. No dedicated rural, religious, trading or lighthouse roles.

candidates.name: Vischer
candidates.notes: Capital/city use different city drawings; hamlet uses a house, fort a castle. Ruins/monuments is a mixed source category: chosen specimen visually reviewed as ruined structures.

candidates.name: Ogilby
candidates.notes: Capital/fort use castles; town uses a large-village road plan. No distinct city sprite. Mine is a historical lead-mine symbol, not an entrance illustration. Two genuine lighthouses were found inside Unique Settlements.

candidates.name: Hogenburg
candidates.notes: Urban-building kit: capital/fort use castles, city a block, town a building group, village/hamlet individual buildings. These are scale proxies, not prebuilt settlement tiers.

excluded.name: CoMiGo
excluded.notes: Downloaded and inspected: 271 SVG designs repeated as black/white PNG. Mostly equipment/UI/skills; only a handful of useful map structures. Earlier 8/10 overstated settlement and POI breadth.

excluded.name: Zatta
excluded.notes: Downloaded and inspected: 507 PNGs, many hachures and abstract fortification/dot markers. Later flintlock/steampunk emphasis and narrow POI range do not meet this project threshold.

additional_research.name: Miko Map Icons
additional_research.state: downloaded and visually inspected; not committed as loose artwork
additional_research.notes: Good building/POI breadth including cave, lighthouse, mine, ruins. Colour cartoon aesthetic. Page permits free game use but archive has no licence document and public raw-asset redistribution is not explicit. Full source archive retained for personal evaluation.

additional_research.name: Limofeus Hand Drawn Dungeon Icons
additional_research.notes: 455 designs including variants; 1820 files means four treatments, not 1820 unique icons. Dungeon props/UI, not a replacement settlement family.
